label: Bladebro lane rule: detect with `command -v bladebro` then `bladebro doctor` (binary currently absent on this host); default to the CLI, and fall back to Bladebro MCP (`bladebro mcp` / `npx -y bladebro mcp` via Code Mode) when chaining with other Code Mode tools or when the CLI is unavailable; if neither lane is available, hand install to the operator because installing is a non-goal.

Chrome DevTools lane rule: detect with `command -v bdg`, `bdg --version 2>&1` and `bdg status` (present at /opt/homebrew/bin/bdg); default to the CLI for low-token inspection and the full 300+ CDP methods/HAR; fall back to Code Mode MCP when the CLI is unavailable, when chaining with other MCP tools, for parallel `--isolated=true` sessions, or for typed TypeScript automation; signed-in work specifically uses `chrome_devtools_live --autoConnect` as Aside's fallback.

Aside lane rule: preflight in order `command -v aside` -> `aside --version 2>&1` -> `aside --help 2>&1` (present at /Users/michelkerkmeester/.local/bin/aside); default to the CLI with agent-task (`aside "<prompt>"` / `aside exec`) and deterministic (`aside repl`) sub-lanes; fall back to `aside mcp` via Code Mode (`aside.aside_repl(args)`) for composition with other tools or MCP-only capabilities, rediscovering the inventory every session.
All three packets share the CLI-first, MCP-for-composition policy, so the hub can express one uniform laneRule shape with per-mode detection and fallback fields.

Bladebro's CLI and MCP reuse the same five handlers, so its fallback is transport-driven rather than capability-driven, unlike Chrome DevTools where MCP is an explicitly documented CDP subset without --list/--describe self-documentation.
Signed-in work is cross-mode-routed: Aside is the default owner, Chrome's --autoConnect live instance is its fallback, and Bladebro's rb on attach/import is a third mechanism that KQ8 must place.

Detection output is version-pinned fixture evidence, not a contract: re-capture --version/--help and the MCP inventory per session, never freeze flags from memory, keep captures out of the repository, and redact cookie/credential values.
